description: This PHP file contains utility functions related to AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) features in SuiteCRM, including functions for generating assignment fields, rendering assignment details, checking if AOP is enabled, retrieving email settings, and parsing templates with custom fields.

methods.name: getAOPAssignField
methods.description: Generates HTML select and input elements for assigning roles or security groups based on provided values.

methods.name: getAOPAssignFieldDetailView
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the assignment field for display in detail view, including role and security group labels.

methods.name: isAOPEnabled
methods.description: Checks if AOP is enabled in the global configuration.

methods.name: getPortalEmailSettings
methods.description: Retrieves email settings for portal notifications, falling back to admin settings if not explicitly configured.

methods.name: aop_parse_template
methods.description: Parses a template string, replacing custom field types with standard types and processing email templates for given beans.
